Test Description: Verify write/read integrity of GPIO GP0 registers gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_27.
Meta Test Description: Register write/read verification for GPIO GP0 register block. Resolved addresses use base 0xA001A000 with offsets 0x0 to 0x4C for MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8 to MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_27 per provided resolution data. SOFT_RST_REG_ADDRESS is present but unresolved in the provided data. The test iterates the resolved registers, performs writes, reads back, and compares results to confirm data retention.
Test Steps / Procedure:
1. Identify the target GPIO GP0 registers gp0_gpio_8 through gp0_gpio_27.
2. For each register, write a test value.
3. Read back the value from each register.
4. Compare the read value with the written value.
5. Record any mismatch and summarize the results.
